title: Yellow Australian Couscous Wrap
description: A quick and easy Australian dish featuring malty couscous, wrapped in a pandan leaf wrap, perfect for a low-fat snack. This dish is a great option for a healthy and delicious meal on the go.
instructions: Rinse the couscous in a fine mesh sieve and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil and add the couscous, covering with a lid.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the couscous is tender.
Fluff the cooked couscous with a fork and stir in the olive oil, salt, and lemon juice.
Arrange a pandan leaf on a flat surface, with the stem end facing you.
Spoon about 1/2 cup of the cooked couscous onto the center of the leaf, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the couscous with grated carrot and chopped scallions.
Fold the bottom edge of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the leaf to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make 3 more wraps.
